hed: Russia resumes Kyiv strikes after U.S. envoys leave; capital pause ends
dek: After Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner’s Moscow then Kyiv weekend talks, the three-day reciprocal pause on strikes against each other’s capitals expired. Early Tuesday Russia hit Kyiv with ballistic missiles; Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported injuries and damage, and Poland began air policing. The envoys had said talks were substantive with hope for trilateral talks; there was still no ceasefire breakthrough.

cl.body: Reuters, Al Jazeera, and POLITICO Europe frame ballistic missiles hitting Kyiv once the capital-strike pause ended, civilian casualties reported by local authorities, and criticism that Putin’s missiles undercut diplomacy after the envoys left.

cr.body: Coverage emphasizing pause expiration timing, White House next-steps-in-weeks framing, and the envoys’ progress remarks without a ceasefire breakthrough yet announced.

seo_description: Russia hit Kyiv with ballistic missiles after a three-day reciprocal capital-strike pause tied to Witkoff and Kushner’s Moscow and Kyiv visits ended.
